title.narrative: THE COLLECTION and DOCUMENTATION OF THE TRADITIONAL COSTUMES

description.narrative: Vanuatu is a vibrant and culturally diverse archipelago in terms of traditional costumes. Each village on the island of Vanuatu has its respective traditional costumes. The practice of making these traditional costumes is also very diverse depending on the villages and the islands. Moreover, with natural disasters, more particularly climate change, and the rise of the sea level, which is advancing at high speed, we must imperatively protect and safeguard our traditional knowledge as well as the plants for manufacturing these cultural artifacts. For this, an inventory should be urgently carried out to assess the situation concerning the plants from which plant is derived and lost. Emphasis should be placed on strategies to re-establish viable stocks of these plants on an island. Traditional exchanges of these costumes should be encouraged to perpetuate their know-how and their manufacture. Knowledge and oral knowledge of the traditional origins of these costumes should be urgently recorded by collecting from the men or women of each village. The production and use of traditional costumes play an essential role in many rituals for the indigenous people of Vanuatu and should be revived and perpetuated. For this, a documentation and photography project should be undertaken for this purpose to document and archive all the stages of the production chain of these traditional costumes.
